caption:
Figure 1: Overview of OmniClinic. Each electronic health record instantiates a patient agent and
defines the case evidence. The sandbox exposes a finite action space spanning clinical consultation
and bedside physical examinations with common clinical tools. The doctor agent selects among these
actions to acquire multimodal evidence before submitting a diagnosis. Examination succeeds only
with the appropriate tool, body region, patient pose, and doctor (agent) position.
delegated_acceptance_review: Reviewed complete final image, caption and paired evidence. Patient/EHR preparation, physical room and tools, closed diagnostic sequence, evidence modalities, interface commands and six action views are intact. Footer's appropriate tool/body region/patient pose/doctor position conditions are explicitly in the caption; no new clinical claim or outcome. Whole original scientific image is independently replayed native.
